name: The Hive Yards (dev only)

do.objective: Two Choristers on the far dock are awake: ride and shoot back

intro.title: THE HIVE YARDS
lines: The machines of Acts C and D, before any map is built on them: belts, cars, the beat, a 30 m shaft, a tide, a collapse.
Every weapon. Nothing runs out. You cannot die. F8 slows the game.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: THE BELT YARD. North lane: the floor runs east, slows, STANDS STILL (amber chevrons), then runs west. South lane: runs 12 s, rests 8. A load drops across the north lane every 10 s.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: Judge: can you read the belt before it turns? Is a stop the right tell? Is walking against a belt fair, or a fight with the floor?

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: THE CAR YARD. Two decks wait 8 s at the west dock, ride east, wait, return. The rim blinks before one leaves. The south car CLIMBS 3 m. The north-wall lever wakes two shooters.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: Judge: does a moving floor under a fight feel good or sick? Is the wait too long? Does stepping on and off feel safe? Is the rim a clear tell?

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: THE BEAT YARD. The light swells every 1.5 s. The nerve bridge blooms a segment at a time, a beat apart, and the bloom travels. The choir on the far island acts only on the beat.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: Judge: is the beat READABLE (light first, then the hazard)? Can you cross by watching the bridge? Do the singers attacking together feel like one voice or a wall?

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: THE TALL SHAFT: a well 30 m deep. Ride the clocked lift up to the north ledge, then step on the plates: each throws you to the next ledge down. Or step off any edge: you dive.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: Judge: does the drop read as a dive? Is 30 m too much or too little? Does the lift wait too long? Do the vents feel like a fall you chose?

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: THE TIDE DOCK. The water comes in over two minutes: first the basin, then the low quay, then the middle terrace; the top never floods. Wet floor slows you. Nobody drowns.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: Judge: can you read the tide coming (the sea, the sound)? Does the slowing feel fair? Is there always dry ground to run to? Is a two-minute clock too slow to watch?

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: THE COLLAPSE YARD. A front of stones starts at the west end of the north road 30 s in and advances a metre a second; behind it the road keeps falling. Stay ahead of it.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: The three bridges SINK once you reach the south road (stairs climb out of the pit), once each: Restart (pause menu) to try again. Judge: fair, or cheap? Does the shake warn you?

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: THE HIVE YARDS (dev): NW the belts, N the cars, NE the beat, W the shaft, E the tide, SW the collapse. The dark yards are in HIVEDARK. Nothing can kill you here.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: THE EXIT is south of here: it goes back to the title.

objective: HIVE YARDS: belts NW, cars N, beat NE, shaft W, tide E, collapse SW
